Description
Gorgeous Views 2-Bed 2-bath Home in Kerrisdale Welcome to 5425 Yew Street, a spacious and inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offering approximately 1,356 sq. ft. of comfortable living space. Thoughtfully laid out with generous room sizes, this home provides an ideal balance of functionality, comfort, and style. The bright living and dining areas create a welcoming setting for relaxing or entertaining, while the well-appointed kitchen offers plenty of space for everyday cooking. Two comfortable bedrooms provide excellent privacy, with two bathrooms adding convenience for residents and guests. Ideally located in a desirable Vancouver neighbourhood, you’ll enjoy easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, transit, schools, and everyday amenities.

Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street 1 block to Kits Beach, this rare 2-level, 1,499 sq ft townhome sits in an exclusive 4-unit boutique strata. Bright layout features 2 beds, den w/ soaring vaulted ceilings, 2 full baths & multiple skylights. Main level offers open-concept kitchen/dining & private deck. Upper level features an airy living room, balcony & generous primary bed. Enjoy a SPECTACULAR PRIVATE ROOFTOP DECK with breathtaking views of the ocean, mountains & skyline. Includes 1 covered carport. Steps to Kits Beach, saltwater pool, tennis courts, Vanier Park & vibrant W 4th/Cornwall dining & shops. Easy transit to Downtown & UBC! If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent.

Private patio off the kitchen as well as includes a private single car garage. Also features one of the largest gardens in the area!
